description: claude-code agent terminates with stop_reason=end_turn while a long-running command (bun install, Monitor poll, background bash) is still in flight. The model emits a natural-language assistant message like 'I'll wait for the install to finish' with no tool call; claude-code's run loop reads that as turn-complete and returns to the operator. In warren there is no operator to send the next prompt, so the run reaps before commit/push/finalize ever runs. Witnessed in run_a98cfx1fantf seq:105-106, compounded with warren-f3bb's silent-empty-branch path. Symptom: result subtype=success is_error=false but workspace branch has zero new commits because the agent self-described as mid-task.
resolution: Updated canopy claude-code prompt (canopy-daf3) v4 with explicit Expectations bullet: 'Never end your turn with work in flight. ... Polling output is not the same as done.' Cheap, narrow, fixes the witnessed instance. For other runtimes hitting variants of this seam, file a separate seed before generalizing — warren-side detection (B) and burrow-side wait-on-subprocess (C) are speculative and were deferred.

title: Audit findings sink re-pointed from warden conversation to seeds (warren-e7e7)
rationale: Phase-A of the conversations deletion pass (pl-3a79) must land before the conversations backend dies. gatewatch/ratchetwatch/tastewatch already file seeds as the durable record; the standing 'Audit Warden' Leveret conversation (POST /conversations/:id/messages + re-wake + meta-Plot) was only an additional synthesis feed. Re-pointed: findings are seeds (labeled audit + auditor), warden-digest now triages open audit-labeled seeds via sd instead of reading a conversation transcript, and files one consolidated digest seed + optional plan. CONSTITUTION Audit Warden boundary amended (RETIRED banner, ingestion rule = seeds, meta-Plot/standing-conversation struck). callback-env.ts token injection kept as a generic loopback-API capability but its conversations-delivery driver comment retired. .warren/triggers.yaml prompts + acceptance scenario 34 dropped. .canopy/ auditor-prompt refs in Article IX deferred to phase-C canopy sweep (warren-6fcd) with a note. Zero /conversations* calls remain in agents/ + triggers.

title: Retire the Audit Warden population; keep nightwatch as the one autonomous example
rationale: The wardens billed tokens nightly/weekly to file findings that accumulated faster than anyone triaged them (~90 seeds lifetime; all 7 open at retirement were obsolete or superseded by warren-f787). The standards they enforced did not depend on them: Articles I and IX are human review rules, and Article II's ratchets are already mechanical CI gates (check:size, check:coverage, check:debt, check:bundle-size). An auditor that only restates what a gate already enforces is a scheduled bill, not a control. They were also orphaned — nothing under src/ ever read agents/*.md, and warden-digest was never in .canopy/prompts.jsonl so it never resolved once (it survived only as the canonical agent-not-found test fixture). Closing warren-a781 as won't-do removed a P1 blocker from the canopy deletion pass (warren-6c0f, warren-f787) rather than gating it on building four more agents first.
